verdict.rationale: The firm documents a dedicated IP practice team covering 'patented and unpatented technology, trademarks, copyright and designs,' confirming trademark work is handled by a named practice group. However, the evidence is a single general practice page without specifics on trademark clearance search, prosecution/registration process, or brand enforcement/anti-counterfeiting litigation track record. Missing for 10: dedicated trademark sub-practice detail, enforcement case examples, clearance/search service description.
